title: Kinetics and mechanism of hydrolysis of PF6− accelerated by H+ or Al3+ in aqueous solution
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00758A, Paper
Takuto Miyashita, Kouji Yasuda, Tetsuya Uda
The hydrolysis of PF6− is more accelerated by Al3+ than by H+, but the hydrolysis of PO2F2− and PO3F2− is more accelerated by H+ rather than by Al3+.
